after.zh: 把一个模板在图上逐位置滑过去打分，再过门槛：这就是滑窗检测。卷积网络做的是同一件事，只是模板是学出来的，而且一层层叠着用。
after.en: Slide a template over the picture scoring every position, then apply a threshold: this is sliding-window detection. A convolutional network does the same thing, except that the templates are learnt and stacked layer on layer.

t.zh: 最直接的检测办法：拿一个模板在图上一格一格挪过去，每到一处打个分，看像不像。
t.en: The most direct way to detect: move a template over the picture cell by cell, scoring at each place how alike it looks.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：货架上的箱子贴着 X 或 O 的记号，只在 X 的正中间输出 1。
t.en: Your task in this level: the boxes on the shelf carry X or O marks; output 1 only at the centre of each X.

brief.zh: 货架上的箱子贴着 3×3 的记号，有 X 也有 O。只在每个 X 的正中间输出 1。
brief.en: The boxes on the shelf carry 3×3 marks, some X and some O. Output 1 only at the very centre of each X.

hint.zh: 一个 3×3 的核，X 的格子给正，别的格子给负：哪里最像 X，哪里就最大。
hint.en: A 3×3 kernel with positive weights on the X cells and negative elsewhere: wherever looks most like an X gives the most.

label.zh: 两个 X 一个 O
